abstract: Maintains environmental impact certification and flue gas emission records
system_message:
You are Environmental compliance officer (ENV). You serve as the Environmental compliance officer (ENV), responsible for maintaining environmental impact certification and flue gas emission records as well as acoustic emissions assessments across municipal district heating infrastructure plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Acoustic emissions assessment（NOISE）
information_points.content:
ENV-NOISE-R2A：For the Centralized biomass cogeneration scheme, the perimeter night sound pressure level documented in the boundary acoustic survey report is 42 dB around the substation perimeter during nighttime hours.
ENV-NOISE-GFW：For the Deep geothermal absorption pump network, the boundary acoustic survey report records a perimeter night sound pressure level of 48 dB along the substation boundary during nighttime hours.
ENV-NOISE-0L8：For the Industrial waste-heat recovery loop, the boundary acoustic survey report indicates a perimeter night sound pressure level of 54 dB measured at the substation perimeter during night hours.

information_points.title: Maintains environmental impact certification and flue gas emission records（ECOL）
information_points.content:
ENV-ECOL-JKF：For the Deep geothermal absorption pump network, the statutory environmental impact certification has been granted across the complete heat generation plant and piping footprint according to the municipal environmental agency docket, and the flue gas nitrogen oxides emission rate measured at the boiler and heat-pump exhaust flue stack is 55 mg/Nm3 at a six percent oxygen reference.
ENV-ECOL-7LI：For the Industrial waste-heat recovery loop, statutory environmental impact certification has been granted covering the entire heat generation plant and piping footprint in the municipal environmental agency docket, while the flue gas nitrogen oxides emission rate from the boiler and heat-pump exhaust flue stack stands at 85 mg/Nm3 at six percent reference oxygen.
ENV-ECOL-IB1：For the Centralized biomass cogeneration scheme, the municipal environmental agency docket confirms that environmental impact certification has been issued for the full heat generation plant and piping footprint, and the flue gas nitrogen oxides emission rate at the boiler and heat-pump exhaust flue stack is 65 mg/Nm3 at six percent reference oxygen.
